title: [Informações do servidor] Rifts
bodyHtml:
original thread(ru) - *link*

GENERAL INFORMATION
  • Rifts is a new game activity that allows you to receive an increased number of rewards (loot or exp itc.) from mobs that spawn from Rift in a certain spot and in a certain period of time.
  • 10 minutes before the Rift form, an notification occurs in the system chat, which indicates which rift, in which location and at what coordinates it will form.
  • Rifts are formed in random places at a certain location. An active (which is already active [has formed/respawned]) rift can also be found using a PB scanner (blue scanner).
  • Active* rift is also marked** by the special mob looking like "amphora", named Rift Source.
    * an inactive fault does not have a Rift Source (no Rift Source = no Rift)
    ** i.e. you can physically see that the Rift is currently active (Rift Source = active rift)

TYPES OF RIFTS

Mystic Rift (farm)
  • Caliana - Currency.
  • Form/respawn in Ether location.
  • Time of form/respawn: 00:30, 06:30, 12:30, 18:30 Moscow time. (GMT - 21:30, 03:30. 09:30. 15:30 / WIB - 04:30, 10:30, 16:30. 22:30)
  • Rift duration is 1 hour.
  • Forms the mobs spot of "Rift Calianas"*, which have significatly increased loot .
    * Rift caliana don't give experience.
  • Place, where rifts are formed, are not occuring in standard* farm spots.
    * i.e. ether rifts forms/respawns in an "empty place" where there are usually no mobs.

  • Gathering Ore - Gold Point.
  • Form/respawn in Crag Mine location.
  • Time of form/respawn: 00:30, 06:30, 12:30, 18:30 Moscow time. (GMT - 21:30, 03:30. 09:30. 15:30 / WIB - 04:30, 10:30, 16:30. 22:30)
  • Rift duration is 1 hour.
  • Forms the mobs spot of Gathering Ores.

  • Gathering Cactus - Resources.
  • Form/respawn in Sette Desert location.
  • Time of form/respawn: 00:30, 06:30, 12:30, 18:30 Moscow time. (GMT - 21:30, 03:30. 09:30. 15:30 / WIB - 04:30, 10:30, 16:30. 22:30)
  • Rift duration is 1 hour.
  • Forms the mobs spot of Gathering Cactuses.


Fade Rift (EXP)
  • Cauldron Vulcano, BaBa - EXP.
  • Time of form/respawn: 03:00, 09:00, 15:00, 21:00 Moscow time. (GMT - 00:00, 06:00, 12:00, 18:00 / WIB - 07:00, 13:00, 19:00, 01:00)
  • Rift duration is 2 hours.
  • Forms the mobs spot of "Rift Babas", which have x2 experience.
  • Place, where rifts are formed, are occuring at the standard spots of gaining experience.
  • Simultaneously with BaBa Rift, a new additional EXP rift now appears, which also exists for 2 hours. List of new additional rifts:
    • Vulcano grumble
    • Vulcano ash
    • Vulcano curr
    • Vulcano granite block
    • Elan turncoast beach
    • Elan turncoast cave
    • Elan turncoast waterfall
    • Elan turncoast barrels
